lines.text: Once the cafe opens for business, things go more smoothly than I expected they would.
Everyone throws themselves into their work with gusto.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: May I take your order?

lines.speaker: femaleguest
lines.text: I'll take one parfait and a slice of cake.

lines.speaker: femaleguest
lines.text: And two of the daily coffee specials.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Got it. We'll have that for you in just a minute!

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ※▣One omurice,※▣one pasta, ※and two coffee specials□▣for table 3.□▣
*Clatter clatter*

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Order up.
Mast handles the front dining area, with Anchor in the back manning the kitchen.
They both work with astonishing professionalism,
so much so that Sin and I, the designated backups, barely have anything to do.
However...

lines.speaker: maleguest
lines.text: Um... Are you okay?

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Ma-Ma...

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Ma-Mamamamamama...!
Despite some minor hiccups, business still runs smoothly.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Now that things are winding down,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: take a break and have some omurice, Master.
Okay then, I w... huh?!
As Anchor hands me a neatly arranged plate of omurice,
I notice a rather unusual garnish on top.
Is that... a starfish?
A starfish is placed proudly.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Don't worry, it's an edible starfish.
Is there even such a thing?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Sure there is. I made it by finely chopping up several variations of Splendamin.
Oh... I see. Thanks.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: The next time we head out to sea, I'll make one with real starfish.
I take a bite of the omurice, being careful to avoid the ersatz starfish.
It's... delicious, actually.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Omurice is always delicious.
I know, but what I mean is,
did you make this yourself?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Yup.
You're good at cooking.
Why are you so good at this?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Uh... Because I'm a maid?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: There's no reason why we shouldn't be good at this.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: After all, consider the tasks we typically handle as part of the Aegis Squad.
Ah...

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Cleaning the Admire, preparing for parties, hosting guests.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Sure, I picked up a few new things from Maid For You,

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: but in reality, there's not much difference between this and what we normally do on the ship.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Yeah. It's easy.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: It sounds to me like you doubted us at first!
Sorry...
Honestly? Yeah, I did.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: We don't blame you.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Apparently, all of the Nikkes who volunteered as maids before were super clumsy,

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: but the Aegis Squad came prepared.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: We were practically born to be maids!
I don't know about that.
... Is that so?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Just kidding.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: But in all honesty, this is way more fun than I thought.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: *Sigh*...
Are you okay, Trony?

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Ye-yeah... for now.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □▣It's about time to□□start getting ready for the dinner shift,※▣isn't it?

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: On second thought... maybe I'm not okay...
Are you really okay?
Why did you volunteer to work as a maid anyway... hmm?
Now that I think about it, the loosely-fitting maid outfit that Trony is wearing looks familiar.
Trony, that maid outfit of yours, did you...

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: I borrowed it from Soda.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: I learned all the necessary skills, but I didn't have anything to wear.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: I worked hard, and passed the audition, but it's exactly as I thought.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Trying something I know nothing about will be the death of me.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: I'm just glad that I wrote my will ahead of time.
Why did you come to work here in the first place?

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: I thought I'd gotten better at talking to others, so I wanted to try something a little harder.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: One day, while I was talking to Elegg...

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: And it was early... and maybe I wasn't thinking straight... but I started to think maybe I'd give it a try.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: I learned all the skills I had to, but it's still a bit... *Sigh*...
All things considered, you seem more composed than I imagine you'd be.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: ... You call that composed?

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ※▣At least she's not※□ foaming at the mouth※□or collapsing.□□

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: It's just that... none of this feels real.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: How should I put it...

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: It's as if I'm completely separated from reality. Yeah, none of this is real...

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Hehe... hahaha...

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Get a hold of yourself, Trony!

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Gah!
Mast grabs Trony firmly by the shoulders.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: You already decided to partake in this, so cast aside all that self-doubt,

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: and enjoy yourself to the fullest!

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: E-enjoy this? But how?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Eat, drink and be merry! Plunder! Go on an adventure!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: That's how a pirate shoul... Oops, wait.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: That's how a pirate maid should live!

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Being a maid is hard enough, now I've got to worry about being a pirate maid?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: First, we'll start you as an ordinary deckhand.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Report to Anchor and learn from her.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: If you try and recruit more pirates into the crew, Helm is gonna chew us out.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Then forget about it!

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: I can't stand getting reprimanded by Helm.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: What about being an honorary member of the crew?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: As long as it's off the record.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Good idea! Problem solved.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: How about it, Trony? Will you become an honorary member of the pirate crew?

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Uh... sure.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Thanks, Mast.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: You too, Anchor.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: All honorary members have to carry this around.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Huh?
*Splat*

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: It's a fresh sea cucumber.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: It's precious, so don't let anyone else see it.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Haha! Now we're family!

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ※▣Would you all be quiet?※▣There are still some customers※□out there.

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: Oh, don't worry! It's okay.
I'm sorry. It's our first day of business, so we haven't quite gotten into the swing of things.

lines.speaker: cheerfulnikke
lines.text: It's no problem, honestly. It's fun to watch you all. Kind of like a comedy sketch.

lines.speaker: cheerfulnikke
lines.text: Would it be okay if we took a picture with

lines.speaker: cheerfulnikke
lines.text: the one dressed in a swimsuit?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Sure, knock yourself out.

lines.speaker: cheerfulnikke
lines.text: So cute!

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: Here, let's take it with my phone.

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: I bought it recently, so the camera is really nice... huh?

lines.speaker: cheerfulnikke
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: It's not turning on. Is it out of battery?

lines.speaker: cheerfulnikke
lines.text: Let's just use mine.

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: Ugh, this is so frustrating. It's been doing this for the past couple days.

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: Um, I'm sorry to bother you,

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: but could you maybe charge my phone?
Sure. Just let me know when you're leaving.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: What pose would you like?

lines.speaker: cheerfulnikke
lines.text: Let's make a heart together with our hands!

lines.speaker: cheerfulnikke
lines.text: Come on, get in here!

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: O-okay!

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: Thanks!
After taking loads of photos, the pair of Nikke fans eventually leave the cafe.
We continue to serve the occasional customer that comes in, and before long, closing time is near.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: There weren't as many customers as I expected.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Maybe because Valentine's Day is still a ways away?

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣※□▣Or maybe because※□we're not famous yet.※□

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Y-you guys think that wasn't a lot of customers?
The pace was definitely more relaxed than normal, yeah.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: You must go to Maid Cafe pretty often in order to know that.
I-I have to stop by a lot for work reasons.
The Maid Cafe will forever have my heart.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Ha, whatever you say, Master Captain.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Whoa, it's that serious?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Master Captain...

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Are you into maids, perchance?
I don't dislike them.
Is there a man out there who doesn't like maids?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Well, I suppose maids are the object of many male fantasies.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □▣Couldn't you▣say the same□for women too※▣▣?

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣▣Many women▣※long to have a chance※to work at□※a Maid Cafe.※▣

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Does that include you as well, Sin?

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ※□▣Of course.□▣You get to wear※▣cute clothes※and meet interesting※□people.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: The notion of you meeting lots of new people sounds kinda dangerous to me...

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: I※simply like※▣talking to people,□▣that's all.□※▣
Just talking to them? Not attempting to manipulate them?

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣□▣□Of course※not.
*Ring ring ring*
Huh?
As we chat, the sound of a bell ringing comes from the counter up front.
I wonder what that is... oh.

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: Um, I'm sorry to bother you,

lines.speaker: hesitantnikke
lines.text: but could you maybe charge my phone?
That customer must have forgotten to take their phone with them when they left.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣□▣Answer it.※It could be them※□calling their own phone.※▣
All right.
I walk over to the counter and pick up the ringing phone.
Hmm?
There's no sign of an incoming call.
Even when I check the screen,
all that shows up is the lock screen.
Is it broken?
*Riiiing*!
Huh?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: What the... what's going on?
I don't know. It just started ringing all of a sudden.
As the phone blares out a frenetic ringtone, the screen turns on...

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Is this the place?
And a hologram pops out of someone familiar.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I can feel the good vibes from here!

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Welcome to Sweets & Cocoa!
